title: VUA packages-ops command v0.1
description: Packages write face, first frozen slice A1 = removal (proposal 026, three-domain stance convergence 2026-09-18: core ruling 82a39c4 five points, environment study 4a0f02f zero-implementation-gap, desktop stance 93752d5; this freeze batch lands the authoritative word face). Exactly two methods, the preview/apply two-verb pair mapped one-to-one onto the VpmBackend port methods preview_remove/apply_remove: packages.previewRemove is the SYNCHRONOUS read-only query (a change preview the user confirms; never mutates), packages.applyRemove is the TASK-DRIVEN write command (nine-state task semantics ride the application-contract task surface, not this schema: commandId idempotency, cancellable, events+revision, no implicit resume — a crashed half-removal re-inspects to inspect_required and retry means the user-triggered preview-then-confirm again, honesty rule 3). Both methods take the SAME registered-path identity as the proposal-013 read face (projectPath); an unregistered path answers the REUSED typed not-found vua.project.project_not_found (same fact, same code, 024 P1 precedent). The removal preview is computed WITHOUT network and WITHOUT dependency resolution against upstream (the smallest-risk write face sets the program template); the confirmedDigest is the FNV-1a digest over the canonical item list that applyRemove binds to — the server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (ORC-WF-003/004 same binding discipline; the desktop may pre-hint but the authoritative verdict lives server-side, proposal-014 arbitration point 2). packageIds is a closed explicit list (minItems 1, uniqueItems): removal of everything means listing every package, no wildcard is invented. packages.previewRemove params carry NO digest slot — the digest is the preview's product, a preview request carrying one is a shape violation. Gate: the wire routes for this family do not exist yet (wiring is the next core slice); serving is capability-gated (VpmCapabilities.remove_packages), a backend without the capability answers the generic capability_missing and the honest-absence wire arm vua.packages.unavailable stays for unwired engines.

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity), same fact and code vua.project.project_not_found when unregistered.

packageIds.description: The closed explicit list of package ids to remove. No wildcard, no 'all' shorthand.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest from the previewRemove result the user confirmed. The server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (vua.packages.preview_drift, recoverable — re-preview, never implicit resumption).
